mapper.insert: INSERT INTO school_admin_invitations (school_id, email, role, status, token, expires_at, invited_by_oauth_user_id) VALUES (#{schoolId}, #{email}, #{role}, #{status}, #{token}, #{expiresAt}, #{invitedByOauthUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM school_admin_invitations WHERE token = #{token} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE school_admin_invitations SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM school_admin_invitations WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} AND email = #{email} AND status = 'pending' LIMIT 1
